set.body: Preserve a reproducible post-L23 source snapshot; independently validate the explicit-J cancellation fallback with reduced examples and finite differences; prove the public API connects initialization, structural capture, pyramid refinement, and canonical output; then run fresh JVM/Scala.js, sealed accuracy, and cost evidence for the exact corrected candidate. The exposed L23 cohort is development evidence only and must not be relabeled as fresh confirmation.
set.title: FA-L24: Requalify corrected linear solver and automatic public pipeline
